name: A/B Research Provenance Graph
intent: Read-only inspection of original local evidence ancestry, native workstation events, unresolved referents and contested relationships without presenting a graph as proof.

witnesses.notes: Source, relationship, transformation, evidence and invalidation remain distinct and traceable.
Visual grammar is a source-bound adaptation, not screenshot copying.
Referenced only for distributing a standalone tool with CLI and docs. No REA code or distinctive interface was copied.

layout.shape: five typed columns with selected record inspector
layout.interaction: inspect actual IDs and recorded boundaries rather than claim completion

avoid: Copied REA images, branding, code and documentation
Replacing owner-backed records with fabricated graph nodes
adaptation_rules: Preserve the repo's cross-layer provenance and trace schema names unchanged
Evidence depth and source references never upgrade themselves to a proof verdict
Render missing parents and absent continuation as explicitly unresolved
Local files remain immutable and the output is an offline visual projection

review.notes: Candidate research visual pending user inspection of a rendered HTML preview.
